mentions.name: tinyAgent
mentions.description: This open-source stack provides a minimal framework for developing AI agents, keeping the learning curve low by avoiding the complexity of larger agent frameworks like CrewAI and LangGraph.
mentions.problem: Existing agent frameworks have a learning curve more than necessary and include fancy features that go unused.
mentions.source_excerpt: So I started building tinyAgent inspired by a post on Huggingface. https://github.com/askbudi/tinyagent
